quests.title: Seeds for Trevenna's Cottage
quests.summary: A resident of Engine House has saved seed for a gardener in Trevenna's Cottage. Take it over and bring back the news.

steps.text: Deliver the seed to Trevenna's Cottage.
steps.line: Ah, her beans! I've been waiting all winter. Tell her I've a bed ready and a very smug cat.

steps.text: Take the thanks back to Engine House.
steps.line: Pleased as punch, was she? Good. Now I'll not have to carry them myself next year.

start.ask: Now then, I've saved a twist of seed for a fellow gardener in Trevenna's Cottage. It's no weight at all. Would you carry it?
start.accept: Keep it dry. They're the best beans in the county, and I'll hear nothing against them.

quests.title: The Tune from Old Jory's Cottage
quests.summary: A resident of Trevenna's Cottage half remembers a tune. Find someone in Old Jory's Cottage who knows how it ends.

steps.text: Hum the tune in Old Jory's Cottage.
steps.line: Dum-de-dum-dum... oh, that's 'The Cobbler's Wife'. It ends on the same note it starts. Tell them.

steps.text: Take the ending back to Trevenna's Cottage.
steps.line: The same note! Of course it does! Thirty years I've been waiting. Thank you.

start.ask: Now then, I've a tune that stops halfway and it's driving me mad. Would you hum it to someone in Old Jory's Cottage? Someone musical.
start.accept: Dum-de-dum-dum. That's it. That's all I've got.
